note: guards b4ad35079c item 2 — compile_funcdef handed each nested body to BUILTIN_REGISTER_COMPILED_FN as base64(bincode(chunk)), so a body nested N deep grew by (4/3)^N and D04parameter#135 hung, taking 118 assertions after it with it. Measured 2026-08-30, LC_ALL=C, depth 40 (297 characters): zsh 0.01 s, zshrs 0.06 s, both `ok`. Before the fix the same shape cost 13.2 s at depth 36 and grew ~3x per level, so a regression shows up here as a TIMEOUT rather than as a wrong answer — which is the only way this harness can express a superlinear-compile bug at all.
